### Prerequisites

We suggest you first read the text about navigating the menus.

### Introduction

The sidebar is organized into sections. Each section groups content of a similar theme and has a title followed by its options. Below, we describe each section and what you will find in it.

### Games

The *Games* section brings the interactive activities of the site:
- **Math**: offers free educational math games and apps.

### Conclusion

With this guide, you now know what each menu of History Tracers offers. Explore the sections and enjoy the content.
